title: Tables
summary: Present data in rows and columns with table, caption, thead, tbody, th and td.

quiz.q: What does `<tr>` stand for in a table?
quiz.explain: `tr` is a table row. Cells (`th` and `td`) go inside it.

quiz.q: Fill in the element for a **header** cell.
quiz.explain: `th` is the header cell, `td` is the ordinary data cell.

quiz.q: Put the parts of a table in the correct order from the top.
quiz.explain: The caption comes first, then the header group, then the body group.

quiz.q: Click the line that does not belong in a table row.
quiz.explain: Inside a `` only `` and `` cells are allowed. Use `88`.

exercise.task:
Build a marks table in `index.html`.

- A `<table>` with a `<caption>` that says `Class marks`.
- A `<thead>` with a row of three `<th>` cells (Name, Maths, Science), each with `scope="col"`.
- A `<tbody>` with at least 2 rows, each with three `<td>` cells.
hints: Draw it on paper first: one header row, two data rows, three columns.
The order inside table is caption, thead, tbody. Each row is a tr and the cells go inside the tr.

checks.name: The table has a caption "Class marks"
checks.hint: Add <caption>Class marks</caption> as the first thing inside the table.

checks.name: The source uses a thead element
checks.hint: Wrap the header row in <thead> and </thead>.

checks.name: The source uses a tbody element
checks.hint: Wrap the data rows in <tbody> and </tbody>.

checks.name: The header row has 3 th cells
checks.hint: Put three <th> cells in one row inside thead.

checks.name: The body has at least 2 rows
The body has at least 6 td cells
checks.hint: Each body row needs three <td> cells.
